done_when: Land lists an item under Merged only when its pull request is merged; otherwise the item stops under Needs you with the reason.

known.title: Not done: Land lists an item under Merged only when its pull request is merged; otherwise the item stops under Needs you with the reason.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a repo uses human merges, or a failed check hands a fix round to a session subagent.
The human-merge path at src/forge/land.py:546–548 puts an unmerged pull request only under Ready to merge, leaving Needs you empty; tests/test_queue_land_all.py:492–511 confirms that behavior. For a subagent handoff, this line records only that the pull request is not merged, rather than the check failure or handoff that stopped the work. The named proofs do not assert either the human-merge destination or the stop reason.
findings.title: Not done: Land lists an item under Merged only when its pull request is merged; otherwise the item stops under Needs you with the reason.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - GitHub accepts a merge request while leaving the pull request open.
The existing check in src/forge/merge.py:208–234 detects the open pull request and makes the child exit nonzero. The queue therefore takes its unchanged nonzero-exit path, never either new zero-exit guard. This test would pass with both guards removed, so it cannot prove the fix; tests/test_merge_command.py:186–189 already checks the underlying refusal.
findings.title: Gate: tests/test_land_merged_means_merged.py::test_1_a_merge_github_did_not_do_never_lists_a_change_as_merged

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - the only failing GitHub Actions check is cancelled during a Land queue run.
The fixture marks the tests check as cancelled but returns a `fail` bucket for that same check. [GitHub CLI maps CANCELLED to `cancel`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/pr/checks/aggregate.go); src/forge/worker.py:557 only selects `fail`, so src/forge/land.py:137–139 stops instead of handing this cancelled check to a subagent. The test therefore does not provide the requested command-level proof for cancelled checks. Neither named test asserts the reason shown under Needs you.
findings.title: Gate: tests/test_land_merged_means_merged.py::test_2_a_fix_round_handed_to_a_session_subagent_is_not_a_merge

why: Land shows an item under Merged when its pull request is still open, so the owner sees a merge that did not happen.
